metadata.description: A decision and prediction ledger with pre-registration, a fresh-context adversary, calibration scoring and a tunable Socratic coach.

plugins.name: cairn
plugins.description: Capture predictions, choices and commitments with a confidence and a date; an adversary argues the other side at full tier; scripts score the record (Brier, calibration, release rate, process, drift); the weekly review forces a choice on every open item. Signals about the record, never verdicts about the person. State lives in ~/.cairn or a project's docs/cairn/.
